voulais.en: You wanted to, I wanted to

texto: For a real or open possibility, **si + présent** is used and then **futur**: **Si j'ai le temps, je voyagerai** (if I have time, I will travel).
For an imagined or unlikely situation, **si + imparfait** is used and then **conditionnel**: **Si j'avais le temps, je voyagerais** (if you had time, travel).
The order may change: **Je voyagerais si j'avais le temps.**
In these two conditional structures, the verb of the part with **si** does not go in futur or conditionnel.
The rule does not apply to all uses of **si**: in an indirect question, any necessary time may appear, including conditionnel: **Je me demande si tu pourrais venir**.
